_comment: CI Monitor configuration. Each value is a regex; absent keys fall back to in-code defaults (see README.md). artifact_name_regex selects which run artifacts carry test-result markers worth downloading. interesting_step_regex selects which step names surface on a non-failing conclusion (genuine failures always surface regardless). test_marker_regex locates the per-test ndjson marker. label_gate_check_regex matches a check-run name that is a process-label gate (not a substantive code/test failure); matched runs are annotated [label gate] in the summary and terminal.
_comment_test_marker: This repo matches BOTH ##GB4PC_TEST## and ##TEST## for back-compatibility while the emit side still writes ##GB4PC_TEST##. The JSON payload begins at the end of whichever alternative matched, so both markers parse correctly. Alternation order does not matter for this pair (neither marker is a prefix of the other); the full marker is simply listed first as a readable convention.
